title: Matched control: the same wheel entered by a chasing move

boundary.expect: second occurrence of the repeating position; not yet terminal

rationale: The matched control for mx-chs-030: from ply 1 onward the two histories stand on byte-identical positions, so they share the four judged White moves at plies 3, 5, 7 and 9 and the result_fen, and differ only in the entry move that leaves the start position. Here the chariot enters with c3a3, swinging across onto the file the cannon stands on, so the entry is itself a chase; in mx-chs-030 it advances along the file its attack already commanded and renews nothing. Red loses at the third occurrence in both, because the entry move lies outside the three-occurrence window either way, and each of the four judged moves renews the chase of the same target: the black cannon is unprotected throughout, black's only other piece being the king on e7, which defends neither a5 nor b5 and never shares a file with the white king. This is a control rather than a patch-gated case because the current unpatched engine already agrees with it while it calls mx-chs-030 a draw, and that split on one identical set of judged moves is the whole content of the pair. The chariot starts on c3, off the wheel, so that the start position occurs once and no position stands three times before ply 9: the asserted third occurrence and the five-ply boundary are the first repetition facts of the game, not restatements of an outcome already reached.
